_readme: THE ONE PLUSH CATALOG. Read by plush/preorder.js on currentsandcritters.com AND on beardedsealstudios.com (it loads this file from currentsandcritters.com), and by plush_reserve.py on the game server, which recomputes every total from it. Change a price, the free-shipping threshold or a spec HERE and nowhere else. test_plush_reserve.py and test_preorder_page.js pin the static copies in index.html to this file.
_bundle: Order freeShippingMin plushies (any mix) and the first bundleMaxItems are bundleDiscountCents off each, in any country, with free standard shipping for the freeShippingCountries. Plushies past bundleMaxItems are full price and their shipping is calculated at checkout. Copy matches the Bearded Seal Studios shop listings.
dealText: Order 3 plushies (any mix) and get free shipping and $5 off each in the USA. Shipping outside the USA is not included.
unlock: Every plushie in the first run comes with a hang-tag code that unlocks the exclusive Fish critter in the online game. First run only.

products.name: Weighted Whale Shark
products.blurb: The gentle giant of the Currents and Critters deck, now something you can hold. Our Weighted Whale Shark is a soft, weighted plush with a satisfying heft, a speckled back full of stars and the friendliest grin in the ocean.
products.fact: Real whale sharks are the largest fish in the sea, and they live almost entirely on plankton.

products.name: Weighted Loggerhead Sea Turtle
products.blurb: A Currents and Critters favorite, ready for your shelf, your couch or your desk. Our Weighted Loggerhead Sea Turtle is a soft, weighted plush with a sunny patchwork shell, sea-glass flippers and a sweet little smile.
products.fact: Real loggerheads navigate by Earth's magnetic field, crossing thousands of miles of ocean to nest on the beach where they hatched.
